user_steering: Freeze restitution and friction; add only2/3 shared parameters, seek Pareto improvement of aggregate and outlier error.
material_policy: Rubber/golf published en/et fixed per surface; mu0.9 remains disclosed assumption. Rocks freeze prior sphere-training en0.49298555778963815 et-0.19158225671821516 mu0.8114839449450747; these are not independently published matched-material values. No en/et/mu optimized.
additional_physical_parameters: s0: shared dimensionless tangential contact-offset intercept
s1: shared incidence dependence, s=s0+s1*vt/sqrt(vn^2+vt^2); r/R=(s,-1)
physical_scope: Effective geometry/inertia hypothesis with positive shared-point contact mobility, exact restitution targets subject to Coulomb capacity, actual kinetic-energy gate. Not measured facet/contactpatch geometry. Inertia is not known experimentally; parameters are not identified material properties.
objectives: Pareto mean squared relative observable-signature discrepancy and maximum discrepancy. q=(abs(vn),abs(vt),R*abs(omega)). Same radius metric, incoming states, fixed material values and measurement signatures for all candidates.
optimizer: SLSQP epigraph maximum-error variable (numerical auxiliary, not a fourth physical parameter). Weights0,.03,.1,.3,1,3,10,30. Fixed multistarts. Reject energy, impulse, constraint failures. Frontier domination computed explicitly.
selection: Among physical frontier candidates that dominate baseline aggregate AND maximum, minimize product of mean-error and maximum-error ratios. No heldout values used for selection. If none, retain baseline.
experiments: All83case calibration frontier as user requested; explicitly in-sample. Separately50rock+6ball training with25rock+2pad development tests. Four leave-one-rock-plate-group fits with ballpad withheld from training. Previously seen datasets are development evidence, not a new blind validation.
report: Per-case improvements/regressions, counts of simultaneous angle/magnitude improvement, fixed parameter hashes, mean/tail metrics, native/independent matrix/energy audits, changed-dot plots. No aggregate-Pareto result called all-case domination unless each case improves.
adoption: No production geometry/material change without measured-geometry transfer evidence; preserve baseline and genuine failures.2x remains removed.

latest_user_override.direction: No project-fitted parameter search. Use documented experimental material-pair parameters and source-matched comparisons; missing values stay missing.
